name: Kooriyama Moka
source:
An icy beauty. Childhood friend of the protagonist.

She has known the protagonist since they were little, and they are studying the same style of massage techniques. She has a cool personality, being calm and collected and rarely showing her emotions. With a certain goal in mind, she formed an organization called Squeeze Girls, and is plotting to take control of the school.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/erom/index.html#CHARACTER]official website[/url]]
